name: Appare! Tenka Gomen [Matsuri] ~Koi to Arashi wa Ooedo no Hana~
original_name: あっぱれ！天下御免［祭］ ～恋と嵐は大江戸の華～
source:
Fandisk for Appare! Tenka Gomen, featuring some new characters and of course lots of icharabu scenes. With the world finally at peace, the students at Ooedo Gakuen prepare for the school festival. However, an inspector from the education head office arrived at the school with ill intentions.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/12/01/december-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
《天降！天下御免》的Fan Disc，收录了一些新角色，当然还有大量的亲热场景。世界终于和平了，大江户学园的学生们正在准备校园文化节。然而，一位来自教育总部的督学带着不良企图来到了学校。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/12/01/december-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
